description: Starts a partner application with the person’s details and returns application_id and application_token. Only call it when the person has asked to join. No text is sent by this call. Next: partner_send_code.

building.description: Optional: the building or company they work with.

employer_ok.description: If they work for a building or concierge company: has their employer allowed it?

mobile_phone.description: The person’s own Canadian mobile number. We text it a code.

payouts_off.description: Optional: true for organisations that cannot take money (for example a university or a settlement agency). Their residents still get the perk; no payouts are ever made.

persona.description: The partner type: how they meet renters (front desk or building staff, leasing agent, mover, tenant insurance, co-living, university, telecom, listing site, relocation, landlord, move-in service, delivery).

name: partner_apply
title: Start a partner application for the person
